nodes.label: Conditional Module Loading
nodes.rationale: Large data payloads are imported only once the feature is switched on; the `typeof window !== 'undefined'` guard keeps the module out of the SSR bundle, shrinking the server bundle and speeding the build.

edges.source_location: both gate a dynamic import() on `typeof window !== 'undefined'` to keep the chunk out of the SSR bundle; they differ only in the trigger (feature enabled vs user intent)
